queries.title: Observation list under common filters
queries.contract: Lists observations filtered by tenant, type, status, and time range, ordered by event_time and seq_no.

queries.title: Trace list with failure and cost summaries
queries.contract: Aggregates observations by trace_id to produce trace-level counts, failure counts, total cost, and total latency.

queries.title: Trace replay ordered by seq_no
queries.contract: Returns the ordered observations for one trace replay target from the primary `agent_observations` surface.

queries.title: Generation and tool chain expansion
queries.contract: Expands parent-child relationships within one trace to show generation-to-tool chains and execution order.

queries.title: Tool failure triage with text relevance
queries.contract: Returns failing tool observations with tenant/app filters and aligned token-based relevance over observation text and nested tool diagnostics.

queries.title: Token, cost, and latency rollup by model and type
queries.contract: Aggregates tokens, cost, and latency by observation type and model.

queries.title: Production-style attr filter across evolving payload
queries.contract: Filters observations using multiple evolving payload.attr dimensions, matching production-style faceted investigation without helper-table flattening.

queries.title: Structured plus term-based text retrieval over observation payload
queries.contract: Combines tenant scoping with aligned token retrieval plus a phrase constraint over input/output and nested tool diagnostics, suitable for text-index-backed execution.

queries.title: Tool usage distribution by name and status
queries.contract: Counts tool observations by tool_name and status across the selected time range.

queries.title: Provider stop reason and cache-hit analysis
queries.contract: Aggregates generation observations by nested payload.provider.stop_reason and payload.provider.cache_hit.

queries.title: App-Scoped Phrase Retrieval Over Incident Observations
queries.contract: Retrieves incident observations for one tenant/app slice using the same aligned token retrieval and phrase constraint over observation text and nested tool diagnostics.

queries.title: Dynamic field facet aggregation over evolving payload dimensions
queries.contract: Aggregates observations by selected payload.attr dimensions such as release ring, customer tier, and retrieval strategy.

queries.title: Operational phrase aggregate over tenant-scoped observations
queries.contract: Counts tenant-scoped operational incident observations and distinct traces when text contains operational phrases such as timeout awaiting headers, retry budget depletion, or transient upstream failure.

queries.title: LIKE-based deployment and rollback keyword retrieval
queries.contract: Retrieves recent generation, tool, and event observations for one tenant/app slice using LIKE-style matching over deployment, rollback, and transient incident keywords.

queries.title: Phrase retrieval over transient failure and timeout incidents
queries.contract: Retrieves tenant-scoped observations containing common operational incident phrases such as transient upstream failure, retry budget depletion, and connector timeout.

queries.title: Low-cardinality dynamic field multi-filter
queries.contract: Filters production observations with low-cardinality payload.attr dimensions such as release ring, customer tier, and traffic cluster.

queries.title: High-cardinality request-key filter over dynamic payload
queries.contract: Retrieves one request slice by filtering on the high-cardinality payload.attr.request_key while also checking workflow_variant in the evolving payload.

queries.title: Prompt template version performance rollup
queries.contract: Aggregates observations by payload.attr.prompt_template_version to compare trace coverage, latency, and cost across prompt template revisions.

queries.title: Incident rollup by deployment channel and release ring
queries.contract: Aggregates error-, timeout-, or retry-like observations by payload.attr.deployment_channel and payload.attr.release_ring.

queries.title: Workflow variant and policy pack operational rollup
queries.contract: Aggregates observations by payload.attr.workflow_variant and payload.attr.policy_pack to compare tenant breadth, latency, and cost.
